objective: Complete and qualify the Rust production migration and a reliable autonomous coding loop for the private Code Factory controller, preserving compatibility, ownership, permissions, receipts, unknown accounting and rollback.
completion_criteria: Production orchestration and installed entrypoints run without Python; required OpenCode JS/TS and approved test runtimes remain available.
An approved useful coding goal is registered and queued, retains one owner across failure/handoff, and repairs a supported failure through only free or included qualified execution.
Independent fresh exact-commit whole-goal checks establish the requested behavior; fake transports and passing implementation tests alone cannot satisfy this criterion.
Usage, cache fields, active/waiting/elapsed time and unavailable accounting are reported truthfully, with unknowns preserved.
The reconciled exact commit passes Factory preflight and main-branch CI, and deployment/rollback is observed without resuming paused research goals.
pause_conditions: A permission, ownership, execution-stop, accounting or publication effect is unresolved.
The approved contained provider or included/free quota policy is unavailable or unqualified; no paid or Astra fallback is permitted.
Remote identity, exact commit, independent evidence or runtime pins cannot be confirmed.
